name: 15145 · Turtle Creek, PA
findings: ZIP 15145 (Turtle Creek) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (56% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15145 (Turtle Creek) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 15145 (Turtle Creek) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 40% of the typical level).
